extraction_scope: 16 key biography events from PKD's life, 1964–1978, with emphasis on 2-3-74 visionary cluster and religious/visionary experiences grounded in both Kyle Arnold clinical analysis and Sutin biographical research.
explicit_topics: Pre-2-3-74 paranoia and amphetamine use context
Dark-haired delivery girl and fish sign as initiating event
Roman Empire visions and historical interpolation
Clinical vs. spiritual interpretations of experiences

claims_made_by_source.claim: On February 20, 1974, a delivery girl with dark hair wearing a fish sign (vesica piscis) necklace triggered PKD's visionary sequence
March 1974 visions included interpolation of ancient Roman Empire into contemporary reality
PKD took ritual action (baptism of son) in response to visionary guidance
Peak integrative moment: vision of being 'Restorer of What Was Lost' on March 16, 1974
Kyle Arnold proposes bipolar mania with paranoid features as clinical frame for 2-3-74
PKD's functioning actually improved during peak visionary period (March-July 1974) despite symptom intensity
Visionary experiences faded significantly after August 1974, following son Christopher's hernia diagnosis and treatment
PKD's pre-2-3-74 amphetamine use created chronic paranoia baseline that contextualized the visionary experiences
1971 house burglary during amphetamine paranoia represented precedent for interpreted reality distortion
February 1976 suicide attempt (triple method: overdose, wrist cutting, carbon monoxide) marked nadir following lost years of Exegesis obsession

important_passages.excerpt: a dark-haired girl in the street outside carrying a large fish sign that seemed to glow
important_passages.why_important: The documented trigger event for the 2-3-74 visionary sequence; initiating moment of mystical awakening

important_passages.excerpt: I was the Restorer of What Was Lost
important_passages.why_important: Peak integrative moment expressing the theological core: the purpose and meaning of the visionary experiences

uncertainties: Whether delivery girl was actually wearing fish sign or PKD projected it onto neutral stimulus
Exact diagnostic category (bipolar vs. TLE vs. other) remains unresolved between Arnold and PKD's interpretation
Whether visionary experiences genuinely faded or PKD ceased reporting them due to changed circumstances
Long-term effects of chronic amphetamine use on PKD's neural physiology not fully documented
Anne Dick's perspective on 1974 events and their aftermath only partially preserved in letters
